svg.aria-label: Pudendal nerve (S2–S4): out of the pelvis and back in round the ischial spine (posterior view) — 阴部神经（S2–S4）：出骨盆后绕坐骨棘返回（后面观）

text.aria-label: Pudendal nerve (S2–S4): out of the pelvis and back in round the ischial spine (posterior view) — 阴部神经（S2–S4）：出骨盆后绕坐骨棘返回（后面观）
text.tspan: Pudendal nerve (S2–S4): out of the pelvis and back in round the ischial spine (posterior view)
阴部神经（S2–S4）：出骨盆后绕坐骨棘返回（后面观）

text.aria-label: Greater sciatic foramen — 坐骨大孔
Lesser sciatic foramen — 坐骨小孔
Piriformis (the nerve leaves below it) — 梨状肌（神经从它下方穿出）
text.tspan: 梨状肌（神经从它下方穿出）

text.aria-label: Inferior rectal nerve — 肛（直肠下）神经
Dorsal nerve of the penis or clitoris (dashed, runs forward) — 阴茎（阴蒂）背神经（虚线，向前走）
text.tspan: Dorsal nerve of the penis or clitoris (dashed, runs forward)
阴茎（阴蒂）背神经（虚线，向前走）

svg.text: The anterior rami of S2, S3 and S4 join inside the pelvis.
S2、S3、S4 的前支在盆腔内汇合。
The nerve leaves through the greater sciatic foramen, below
经坐骨大孔、在梨状肌下方出骨盆。
It hooks round the sacrospinous ligament at the ischial spine.
在坐骨棘处绕过骶棘韧带。
It re-enters through the lesser sciatic foramen.
It runs in the pudendal (Alcock) canal on the lateral wall of the
走在坐骨肛门窝外侧壁的阴部管（Alcock 管）内。
It divides into the inferior rectal nerve, the perineal nerve and
the dorsal nerve of the penis or clitoris.
分为肛（直肠下）神经、会阴神经和阴茎（阴蒂）背神经。

text.tspan: Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
